## Required

12 fields: trip/set IDs; start/end times and positions; bird-scaring; two observed counts; sampling protocol.

## Available

All 461 sets have hauling times and positions. The source includes observer and self-reporting trips.

Hooks set cannot be reused as the number retrieved or observed. The hook-timer flag does not show observer coverage.

## To decide

Establish observed hook/branchline counts, actual sampling protocol and bird-scaring information.

Keep optional offal information empty without evidence. Do not reuse Philippe's fixed values.

An empty sheet is structurally possible if no bite-off rows depend on it; the reporting rule remains open.
